about.title: Who's behind this
text: I'm Ahmad Akbary. I build software for businesses and humanitarian organizations, from sales and HR systems to monitoring and evaluation dashboards.
My goal is simple: tools your team actually uses, in the language you work in.

reasons.title: Try before you decide
reasons.text: Open a live demo and add your own test data before we even talk.

reasons.title: In your language
reasons.text: We can talk, and your system can work, in Dari, Pashto or English.

reasons.title: Built from field experience
reasons.text: Hands-on monitoring and evaluation work shapes every dashboard.

reasons.title: Support after launch
reasons.text: Training for your team, and help when something needs to change.
